description.value:
You surround yourself with a biotic field and launch forward in a devastating dash, crashing into enemies with tremendous impact force. You move up to 60 feet in a straight line towards an enemy you can see, so long as that enemy does not have total cover, phasing through any obstacles in your path. That target must attempt a @Check[reflex|dc:resolve(13+@actor.system.details.level.value+floor(@actor.system.details.level.value/3))|options:me-power:me-npc-biotic-charge] save against the creature's power DC.

Critical Success Unaffected.

Success The target takes @Damage[(1*(1+floor(@actor.system.details.level.value/4)))d6[bludgeoning]] damage.

Failure The target takes @Damage[(3*(1+floor(@actor.system.details.level.value/4)))d6[bludgeoning]] damage and is knocked prone. Your Biotic Barrier recharges half of its maximum barrier HP.

Critical Failure As failure, but @Damage[(6*(1+floor(@actor.system.details.level.value/4)))d6[bludgeoning]] damage and pushed 5 feet away from you. Your Biotic Barrier recharges to full.

Recharge The creature can't use this power again for [[/br 1d4 #Recharge]]{1d4 rounds}.

NPC version. Its DC is 13 + level + a third of level (the moderate DC for the creature's level), and its damage dice multiply every 4 levels. When a creature rolls the save, the result is applied automatically (see the Auto-Apply Power Effects setting).
